strategies.strategy_title: 策略一：高檔避險與資金避風港（金融、航空、ETF）
strategies.strategy_content: 肖年仔，你看外資、投信、自營商三大法人，不約而同地狂掃航空雙雄（華航、長榮航），還有金融股（第一金、玉山金、合庫金），連ETF（0050、0052）都買爆。這擺明了就是大盤在高檔震盪，資金從高風險的科技股撤出，轉往有防禦性、有旺季題材（解封觀光）的板塊。金融股有高殖利率題材，ETF則是最好的避險工具，這就是大戶在找資金避風港，準備過冬啦！

strategies.strategy_title: 策略二：低基期與景氣循環股卡位（水泥、DRAM、石化）

strategies.strategy_content: 你看面板三雄（友達、群創、彩晶）被三大法人同步大賣，外資倒貨最兇，摩根大通這種大咖分點也狂賣友達 4616.64 萬張，這不是出貨是什麼？這擺明了就是主力在倒貨給散戶接刀，肖年仔，這種被法人集體拋棄的股票，千萬不要去接刀，不然會被割韭菜割到見骨啦！

english_professor_news.title: Kalshi asks CFTC to allow margin trading on prediction markets

level1_blind.text:
Kalshi filed on Tuesday with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission seeking approval to offer leverage on its event contracts, a move the company says is aimed at drawing institutional traders to its prediction markets, according to CNBC.

The filing came from Kalshi Klear, the company's internal clearinghouse. With margin trading, a trader uses borrowed funds to gain exposure to more of an asset than their own cash would cover — a standard practice in equities and derivatives markets, though one not yet permitted on regulated U.S. event contract exchanges, where all positions are currently fully collateralized.

In a memo provided to CNBC, Kalshi said leverage would make longer-dated prediction markets more attractive to institutions. Kalshi also described plans for a tiered structure in which the collateral needed to maintain a leveraged position would rise the closer a contract gets to settling.

Access to leverage, if the CFTC signs off, would be restricted to self-clearing members who satisfy specified capital thresholds given their direct clearing relationships with Kalshi Klear, a company spokesperson confirmed. The company said it would not offer margin on sports event contracts, or on its culture and "mention" markets.

Leverage is already a feature on Kalshi's perpetual futures products, but the company has not yet cleared the regulatory bar to extend it to its prediction market offerings.

The push for margin access reflects a broader effort by prediction market platforms to attract institutional participation. Polymarket, a rival, made moves in July to obtain regulatory licenses that would eventually allow it to offer margin trading on event contracts in the U.S., according to CNBC.

Tuesday's filing is the latest in a string of expansion moves by Kalshi. The platform launched a professional trading terminal for its most active users, offering features including deeper order book visibility and risk management tools for perpetual positions. The company accounts for more than 90% of prediction market activity in the U.S., with annualized trading volume climbing from $52 billion to $178 billion over six months.

Kalshi has also been expanding internationally. The company partnered with brokerage infrastructure startup Alpaca to make its event contracts available to users outside the U.S., and earlier partnered with Canadian financial firm Wealthsimple to bring its markets to Canada.

level2_keywords.meaning: 指「保證金交易」或「融資交易」，投資者透過借款來增加其投資部位的規模，以放大潛在收益，但同時也伴隨更高的風險。
level2_keywords.example: 「Margin trading allows investors to amplify their returns, but also their risks.」

level2_keywords.meaning: 「預測市場」是一種讓參與者可以針對未來事件的結果進行交易的平台，例如選舉、經濟數據或體育賽事，其價格通常反映了市場對該事件發生的機率預期。
level2_keywords.example: 「Prediction markets enable participants to bet on future events, from elections to economic indicators.」

level2_keywords.meaning: 「美國商品期貨交易委員會」的縮寫，是美國政府的一個獨立機構，負責監管美國的期貨和選擇權市場，確保市場的公平、透明和金融穩定。
level2_keywords.example: 「The CFTC regulates the U.S. derivatives markets, ensuring fair and transparent trading.」

level2_keywords.meaning: 在金融領域指「槓桿」，意即利用借入的資金來增加投資回報的潛力。雖然可以放大收益，但也會同時放大虧損的風險。
level2_keywords.example: 「Using leverage can significantly increase potential gains or losses in financial markets.」

level2_keywords.meaning: 「事件合約」是一種特殊的金融合約，允許交易者針對特定現實世界事件的結果進行投機或對沖，例如某個經濟數據是否會達到特定水平。
level2_keywords.example: 「Event contracts allow traders to speculate on the outcome of specific real-world events.」

english_professor_news.level2_context:
各位同學，這篇新聞談的是美國一家名為 Kalshi 的「預測市場」平台，他們正在向美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）申請，希望能在其「事件合約」產品上提供「保證金交易」（也就是我們常說的「槓桿」）。

為什麼這很重要呢？因為目前在美國，受監管的事件合約交易所是不允許保證金交易的，所有部位都必須「全額抵押」。這對於想投入大筆資金的「機構投資者」來說，資金使用效率不高，吸引力也大打折扣。Kalshi 爭取開放槓桿，就是希望能降低機構參與的門檻，讓他們能用更少的資金，參與更大規模的交易，進而擴大整個預測市場的規模和流動性。

這不僅是 Kalshi 一家公司的努力，更是整個預測市場產業希望「主流化」的趨勢。如果 CFTC 批准，這將是美國金融市場的一個重要里程碑，可能為預測市場帶來更多機構資金和交易量，使其從一個相對小眾的市場，逐步走向更廣闊的金融舞台。我們可以看到，連競爭對手 Polymarket 也在做類似的努力，這顯示了產業對此的共同期待。同時，Kalshi 也積極拓展國際市場，並提升其交易平台的專業功能，這些都是為了吸引更多元、更專業的交易者，進一步鞏固其在市場上的領導地位。這是一個值得我們持續關注的財經科技發展趨勢喔！

english_professor_news.title: Bessent just picked the one wage measure still rising

level1_blind.text:
Politicians have a favorite number. The trick is finding one that is true, flattering, and narrow enough that nobody checks what sits next to it.

Wage data makes that easy. The government publishes dozens of pay measures every month, covering hourly and weekly pay, managers and rank-and-file staff, factory floors and restaurant kitchens, with many of them also adjusted for inflation.

In a good year, most of those measures point in the same direction. In a rough year, they split apart, and whoever holds the microphone gets to choose which one you hear about.

This has been a rough year for your grocery and gas budget. Gasoline costs 27.4% more than it did a year ago, and the Federal Reserve just raised interest rates for the first time since 2023.

For most households, that combination adds up to a paycheck that buys a little less than it did last summer.

So when Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent went looking for good news about American wages on Monday, Sept. 21, he had to be choosy. He found two numbers that still look great, and both belong to people who build things for a living.

A raise only counts if it outruns prices. Economists call what is left over "real" wages, and it is the closest thing the government has to a measure of whether your paycheck is truly growing.

Right now, that measure is flashing yellow. Real average hourly earnings for all private-sector employees fell 0.3% from August 2025 to August 2026, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).

level2_keywords.meaning: 衡量薪資水平的指標或數據。
level2_keywords.example: 「The government uses various wage measures to track economic health.」 (政府利用各種薪資衡量指標來追蹤經濟健康狀況。)

level2_keywords.meaning: 經濟數據經過通膨因素調整，以反映真實購買力。
level2_keywords.example: 「To understand real economic growth, we need data adjusted for inflation.」 (為了了解真實的經濟成長，我們需要經過通膨調整的數據。)

level2_keywords.meaning: 銀行或金融機構對借貸資金收取的費用百分比，通常由央行政策影響。
level2_keywords.example: 「The Federal Reserve raised interest rates to curb rising prices.」 (聯準會調高利率以抑制物價上漲。)

level2_keywords.meaning: 財政部長，負責國家財政政策、稅收和國債等事務的政府高級官員。
level2_keywords.example: 「The Treasury Secretary commented on the latest jobs report.」 (財政部長針對最新的就業報告發表了評論。)

level2_keywords.meaning: 實質薪資，指薪資扣除通膨影響後，實際購買力的變化。
level2_keywords.example: 「Despite nominal wage increases, many workers saw their real wages decline due to high inflation.」 (儘管名目薪資有所增加，但由於高通膨，許多勞工的實質薪資卻下降了。)

english_professor_news.level2_context: 各位同學，這篇新聞在探討一個很常見的政治現象：當經濟數據不盡理想時，政府官員如何「選擇性」地呈現數據，以營造出較為正面的形象。文章指出，美國財政部長史考特·貝森特（Scott Bessent）在面對通膨高漲、聯準會升息導致民眾購買力下降的背景下，刻意挑選了少數仍在成長的薪資指標來強調經濟表現。這背後反映的是，儘管名目薪資可能有所增加，但若考慮到物價上漲，許多家庭的「實質薪資」其實是縮水的。這種操作手法在財經界很常見，我們在解讀新聞時，必須學會看穿這些數字遊戲，理解其背後的宏觀經濟現實，才能真正掌握經濟脈動。

level3_translation.sentence: Politicians have a favorite number.
level3_translation.translation: 政治人物都有他們偏愛的一組數字。

level3_translation.sentence: The trick is finding one that is true, flattering, and narrow enough that nobody checks what sits next to it.
level3_translation.translation: 訣竅在於找到一個既真實、又討喜，而且範圍夠窄，讓旁人不會去深究其背後細節的數字。

level3_translation.sentence: Wage data makes that easy.
level3_translation.translation: 薪資數據讓這件事變得輕而易舉。

level3_translation.sentence: The government publishes dozens of pay measures every month, covering hourly and weekly pay, managers and rank-and-file staff, factory floors and restaurant kitchens, with many of them also adjusted for inflation.
level3_translation.translation: 政府每個月都會公布數十種薪資衡量指標，涵蓋了時薪、週薪、經理人與基層員工、工廠生產線與餐廳廚房等各行各業，其中許多數據也都會經過通膨調整。

level3_translation.sentence: In a good year, most of those measures point in the same direction.
level3_translation.translation: 在經濟狀況好的年份，這些指標大多會指向同一個方向。

level3_translation.sentence: In a rough year, they split apart, and whoever holds the microphone gets to choose which one you hear about.
level3_translation.translation: 但經濟艱困的年份，它們就會分歧，這時候誰握有發言權，就能選擇要讓大家聽到哪一個數字。

level3_translation.sentence: This has been a rough year for your grocery and gas budget.
level3_translation.translation: 對於各位的民生採買和汽油預算來說，今年是個艱難的年份。

level3_translation.sentence: Gasoline costs 27.4% more than it did a year ago, and the Federal Reserve just raised interest rates for the first time since 2023.
level3_translation.translation: 汽油價格比一年前上漲了27.4%，而且聯準會才剛進行了自2023年以來的首次升息。

level3_translation.sentence: For most households, that combination adds up to a paycheck that buys a little less than it did last summer.
level3_translation.translation: 對於大多數家庭來說，這種情況意味著薪水能買到的東西比去年夏天少了一點。

level3_translation.sentence: So when Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent went looking for good news about American wages on Monday, Sept. 21, he had to be choosy.
level3_translation.translation: 因此，當財政部長史考特·貝森特在9月21日週一尋找關於美國薪資的好消息時，他必須精挑細選。

level3_translation.sentence: He found two numbers that still look great, and both belong to people who build things for a living.
level3_translation.translation: 他找到了兩個看起來仍然很棒的數字，而且這兩個數字都屬於那些以「製造東西」維生的人。

level3_translation.sentence: A raise only counts if it outruns prices.
level3_translation.translation: 薪資調漲只有在「跑贏物價」時才算數。

level3_translation.sentence: Economists call what is left over "real" wages, and it is the closest thing the government has to a measure of whether your paycheck is truly growing.
level3_translation.translation: 經濟學家將扣除物價上漲後剩下的部分稱為「實質薪資」，這是政府衡量你的薪水是否真正成長的最接近指標。

level3_translation.sentence: Right now, that measure is flashing yellow.
level3_translation.translation: 而目前，這個指標正亮起「黃燈」。

level3_translation.sentence: Real average hourly earnings for all private-sector employees fell 0.3% from August 2025 to August 2026, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).
level3_translation.translation: 根據勞工統計局（BLS）的數據，所有私部門員工的「實質平均時薪」從2025年8月到2026年8月下降了0.3%。

english_professor_news.title: Grant Cardone offers 10 Bitcoin bounty on finding a buyer for his private jet
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
Grant Cardone took to X to announce he will pay 10 BTC, worth several hundred thousand dollars, to whoever brings him a qualified buyer for his 2024 Global 7500 jet.

The aircraft in question has four cabins and just 200 hours of flight time, still under warranty.

According to Cardone, the buyer must be introduced directly to his team, not a broker, and the person making the introduction must help see the deal through to closing.

If multiple people are involved in bringing the deal together, the Bitcoin reward will be split among them.

"This does not guarantee you payment for a name or referral or a mention. To earn 10BTC you must introduce the actual buyer to my team (not to a broker) and assist in bringing deal to a close as advertised above. If you elect to bring in help or other players the BTC will be shared," he announced on X.

Cardone listed the jet for sale earlier this month at $80 million, directing serious buyers to email his team at Cardone Capital.

In his listing, Cardone also took a swipe at trade policy, claiming tariffs have effectively blocked Bombardier jet sales in the United States, a dynamic he framed as basic supply and demand working in his favor.

"For Sale 2024 Global 7500- 4 cabins, 200 hours, No Tariffs, $80M. Only Serious Buyers. Trump forbids sales of Bombardier in the United States. Supply & Demand, Thank you sir," he wrote on X.

level2_keywords.example: 該公司的飛機受到影響

english_professor_news.level2_context: Grant Cardone 的私人飛機出售，該飛機具有四個艙，使用時間少於 200 小時，仍有保證期。這是他為了挑戰美國政府對巴門得航空的關税政策而做出的姿勢，希望通過基本的供應與需求原理來推動自己的商業活動.

level3_translation.sentence: Grant Cardone took to X to announce he will pay 10 BTC, worth several hundred thousand dollars, to whoever brings him a qualified buyer for his 2024 Global 7500 jet.
level3_translation.translation: 格雷特·卡德內（Grant Cardone）在社交媒體 X 上宣布，他將為找出能夠買下他的 2024 年全球 7500 飛機的有資格買家而付 10 個 Bitcoin，價值數十萬美元。

level3_translation.sentence: The aircraft in question has four cabins and just 200 hours of flight time, still under warranty.
level3_translation.translation: 該飛機具有四個艙，使用時間少於 200 小時，仍有保證期。

level3_translation.sentence: According to Cardone, the buyer must be introduced directly to his team, not a broker, and the person making the introduction must help see the deal through to closing.
level3_translation.translation: 根據卡德內，買家必須直接與他的團隊接觸，而不是中間人，且與買家接觸的人必須幫助完成交易的關閉。

level3_translation.sentence: If multiple people are involved in bringing the deal together, the Bitcoin reward will be split among them.
level3_translation.translation: 如果多個人參與將交易進行完成， Bitcoin 奖金將被分配給所有參與者。

level3_translation.sentence: "This does not guarantee you payment for a name or referral or a mention. To earn 10BTC you must introduce the actual buyer to my team (not to a broker) and assist in bringing deal to a close as advertised above. If you elect to bring in help or other players the BTC will be shared," he announced on X.
level3_translation.translation: "這不保證你會得到名字或參與者名單的報酬或提名。要獲得 10 個 Bitcoin，你必須將真正的買家帶到我的團隊（而不是中間人）並幫助完成交易。若你選擇將幫助或其他玩家加入， Bitcoin 奖金將被共享,"他在 X 上宣布。

level3_translation.sentence: Cardone listed the jet for sale earlier this month at $80 million, directing serious buyers to email his team at Cardone Capital.
level3_translation.translation: 卡德內在上個月早些時候將該飛機售價 8 億美元，建議嚴肅的買家通過電子郵件與他的團隊聯繫。

level3_translation.sentence: In his listing, Cardone also took a swipe at trade policy, claiming tariffs have effectively blocked Bombardier jet sales in the United States, a dynamic he framed as basic supply and demand working in his favor.
level3_translation.translation: 在他的列表中，卡德內還對貿易政策進行了一次攻擊，認為關税已經有效地阻止了巴門得航空飛機在美國的出售，該動態他把視為基本的供應與需求原理在他的利益之中。

level3_translation.sentence: "For Sale 2024 Global 7500- 4 cabins, 200 hours, No Tariffs, $80M. Only Serious Buyers. Trump forbids sales of Bombardier in the United States. Supply & Demand, Thank you sir," he wrote on X.
level3_translation.translation: "出售 2024 年全球 7500 飛機- 4艙，使用時間少於 200 小時，無關税， 8 億美元。僅嚴肅的買家。特朗普禁止在美國出售巴門得航空飛機。供應與需求，感謝您，先生,"他在 X 上寫下。

market_linker_insight.market_connection: 兩個新聞報導中提到的 prediction market 和 Bitcoin 的交易，可能與金融市場的波動有關。 prediction market 的 introduction 可能會影響到 Bitcoin 的交易量，從而影響到金融市場的波動。另一方面，金融市場的波動也可能影響到 prediction market 的交易量。因此，需要密切監測這兩個市場的變化，從而能夠更好地預測金融市場的波動。
